$comment: S1 output. Machine-readable replacement table for the S2 sweep. Generated 2026-08-31 02:40 EDT by the S1 seat from S1-token-vocabulary.md (RULED 2026-08-25 14:32 EDT). DO NOT hand-edit token names here: S1 is the authority. If S1 does not name a token, the entry carries token:null and safe_for_script:false.
keying_rule: Every entry is keyed on PROPERTY + VALUE, never value alone. `border-radius: 4px` and `padding: 4px` are different tokens; a value-only map corrupts ~750 sites.
script_rules: Match a WHOLE declaration value, never a substring. `8px` inside `calc(100% - 8px)` or inside `rgba(0,0,0,0.55)` is not a site.

FENCE 4 — src/instruments/chord-module.js:1624 carries a literal NUL byte. The shell's grep (ugrep -I) classifies the whole 78 KB file as binary and returns NOTHING, silently. Use /usr/bin/grep -a or Python. A zero on that file is FENCE 4 until proven otherwise. Do not strip the NUL: it is load-bearing application code.
FENCE 3 — derived tokens (--r-*, --fs-*, --sp-*) are `*`-scoped. Never re-declare one in :root, never give a root knob a relative unit.

expected_sites is S1's published occupancy figure. measured_sites is this seat's count (Python, 16 style-bearing files, 2026-08-31). Where reconciles:false, the two disagree and the entry is BLOCKED pending Brandon's ruling — see receipt-S1.md.
A safe_for_script:false entry is never a find-replace. It is hand work, a variant-block change, or an escalation.

entries.reason: COMPOUND, ALL OF THEM. Every one of the 12 duration occurrences (across 9 declarations) lives inside a `transition` shorthand, so none is a value replace; each becomes `<property> var(--dur-*) var(--ease)`. AND the mapping is unruled — see the two entries below. The site count DOES reconcile with S1 §1 (12).

BLOCKED — BRANDON'S RULING NEEDED. S1 §6 collapses the durations into --dur-fast (80ms) and --dur-med (120ms) but never says which measured value goes to which token. Only 80ms and 120ms are self-evident. Nearest-knob would give 60/70/90 -> --dur-fast and 150 -> --dur-med, but that is this seat's arithmetic, not S1's ruling, and 90ms is the borderline case.
Correct token, but it only ever appears as a component of a `transition` shorthand — never as its own declaration.

FENCE 2 — SVG. wave-synth.js and scale-circle.js build SVG via createElementNS and style through PRESENTATION ATTRIBUTES, which accept var() inconsistently. Rule: move the value into the CSS block where the surface already has one; if it must stay an attribute, read the token in JS and write the resolved value. Never leave a raw number. SEPARATELY: S1 names no token for sub-pixel stroke widths — --bw is 1px. ESCALATION.
FENCE 2 — same rule as stroke-width. Any `font-size` set as an SVG attribute rather than in a CSS block is hand work, not a replace. Enumerating these is S2's lane, not S1's.
